_comment: GENERATED by scripts/ccc/audit_map.py — stem -> existing catalog record. The sync writes to the record named here and stamps template_name on it. Evidence, strongest first: template_name, slug with the legacy share id stripped, unique normalized title, graph fingerprint, version successor. Ambiguous candidates live in .ccc-work/pending.json (not committed) and gate nothing: a stem absent here is created as a new record.
_catalog_owned_comment: catalog_owned: fields this sync must never write for that record, because the value on comfy.org is authored there (or is ahead of the repo) and the repo has no newer text to replace it with. Default is the opposite: a field not listed here is repo-owned and gets written. 'graph' holds the whole workflow pair (workflow-ui-v1.json + workflow-api-v1.json), because a media file cannot be merged field by field. Seeded 2026-11-22 from the full drift audit of 494 mapped records (662 text deltas): a field is held unless git history proves the repo replaced that exact string later (repo_newer). Remove an entry by hand once the two sides are reconciled.
